chunks.text: Guys, before starting the video, I want to make a small request.
We work very hard and spend a lot of money in lab testing
so that you can choose the right product in your life.
And even after that, maximum number of people haven't subscribed to our channel.
If you really get help from our channel in choosing a better product,
then please share our channel with your friends and family.
And you also subscribe to it so that you can choose safe and be safe. Thank you.
Hello everyone, welcome back to Testified, India's first and only 100% blind tasting certification program.
You must have heard a viral news recently where an employee of a former McDonald's
revealed that there is a coliform bacteria in the ice cream of McDonald's.
Yes, the same bacteria which is found in fecal contamination.
That bacteria is more than safe limit in the ice cream of McDonald's.
But this is not a credible news.
We are going to solve it.
We can't believe it as a valid news because it is going viral through a reel.
There is no identification in it.
That's why we can't believe this reel as credible.
But when it comes to credibility, then nothing works better than 100% blind testing.
That's why we got McDonald's ice cream blind tested.
Look, it is not a healthy product but considering that McDonald's is a US-based multinational fast food chain giant,
which is also number one in the world,
that's why we thought of verifying this claim.
And verifying it is basically because I have seen that many parents take their kids to McDonald's.
And the kids enjoy both these ice creams which you can see on my screen.
Even many birthday parties are organized by kids in McDonald's.
So from the point of view of a kid, I thought that it is necessary to verify this claim.
Sample collection.
Lab did the sample collection as you can see in the report because it is an ice cream.
That's why for its testing, lab collected the sample in a temperature maintenance kit through validated collection method
to ensure the integrity of the sample throughout the transit.
And after that, its testing was performed.
For blind testing, we did blind testing of these two only which are soft serve vanilla cone and Maxwell chocolate.
Because these are the two variants which are most popular.
And they are sold the most through the outlet of McDonald's.
First of all, let's talk about the blind testing result of soft serve cone.
So as you can see in the report of microbiological of soft serve cone,
in that coliforms are found to be 4x of safe limit.
In the same report of Maxwell chocolate, you can see that coliforms are found to be 6x of safe limit.
You can see the conclusion of these two reports on my screen.
On the top, you can see the conclusion of the report of soft serve cone.
And on the bottom, you can see the conclusion of Maxwell chocolate report.
So, we have talked about my reports till here.
But now let's talk about some such incidents which are real and not real.
Incident number 1.
In 2017, BBC has published around 30 fast food outlets of the UK including McDonald's.
KFC and Burger King's ice samples were tested.
In which, in the sample of 3 outlets of McDonald's,
coliform bacteria i.e. fecal contamination indicator was found.
Whereas, in the sample of 6 outlets of Burger King and KFC,
this bacteria was also found.
When these things were revealed in the investigation,
then these giant foreign companies asked to improve cleaning, staff training and machine sanitization in response.
Incident number 2.
In 2004, McDonald's was also fined in Hong Kong.
When authorities tested an ice cream of an outlet on Sunday.
And in that, bacteria count was 2,40,000 per gram.
Which was much more than the legal limit of 50,000 per gram.
Incident number 3.
In 2025, a report was highlighted in which an old reference of the inside edition test was given.
Where 40 soft serve ice cream samples were tested.
And in those 8 samples, coliform bacteria was found.
This investigation partly took place when a McDonald's employee shared a photo of a dirty drip tray inside the machine.
After this, people were shocked.
But the company clarified that that part does not come in food contact and is regularly cleaned.
All these real incidents that I have just covered are from outside India.
I don't know whether these things are covered in India or not.
But being an Indian, we thought that especially for Indian kids,
Why not blind test these two ice creams of McDonald's from an outlet in India.
Lastly, I want to say one more thing.
Look, the fact that coliform bacteria is not found means that it has come directly from the poop.
It means hygiene failure.
Coliform bacteria can basically still come in ice cream when the cleaning of the machine is not done properly.
The hygiene of the staff is weak.
Or the contaminated water in the system has been used.
It is not necessary that the level of the coliform bacteria that has been found makes you sick.
But it shows somewhere that the structure of the cleaning in the system has broken.
And if this level continues to increase, more contaminated bacteria can grow.
Which can worsen the matter.
So the main issue is not of the bacterial level.
The main issue here is that
Even in such a big multinational fast food giant,
If the basic hygiene structure is not maintained,
Then it is not worth ignoring.
Before closing the video, I want to mention one very important thing.
In the interest of transparency and fair journalism,
On 9th May, we sent an email to McDonald's in 2026.
Which you can see on the screen.
In this email, we informed them that in our blind test,
In both their ice creams, coliform bacteria will be more than safe limit.
McDonald's response was given to us on the same night at 11.49 pm.
Where they asked for some additional details and lab test report from us.
We shared all the required details and lab report with them.
After that, we were told that the outlet from which we collected the sample,
Comes under McDonald's Connaught Plaza restaurant.
Basically, the outlets of North and East India of McDonald's,
Connaught Plaza restaurant handles.
Whereas the outlets of South and West India,
Comes under Hard Castle restaurant.
Because our initial email went to Hard Castle restaurant,
We were told that this issue should be raised with Connaught Plaza restaurant.
That's why we forwarded the entire email chain to Connaught Plaza restaurant,
And asked them for clarification.
But after sending the email and after 24 hours of uploading the video,
We have not received any response from them.
If they get any response later,
We will add it in the description box.
Thank you for watching.
Please subscribe to our channel.
And press the bell icon.
To get notified of our latest updates.
Thank you.
Thank you.
